//DoomLoopThreshold: Repeated tool-call sequences before the doom-loop nudge fires (default 3). 0 or less disables the detector. A program's `loop` directive overrides per run.
//TokenBudget: Session-cumulative token ceiling; the run aborts (exit_reason token_budget, exit 3) once total usage crosses it. 0 = unlimited. A program's `budget tokens` directive overrides.
//WallClockBudgetMs: Session-cumulative wall-clock ceiling in ms; the run aborts (exit_reason time_budget, exit 3), cancelling the in-flight model call, once elapsed time crosses it. 0 = unlimited. A program's `budget wall_ms` directive overrides.
//Approval: Optional approval policy. Bash: auto-approve bash commands matching these patterns (extends --approve). McpTools: allow globs matched against the {server}_{tool} name ('/' aliases '_', so 'fs/*' matches 'fs_read'). Default: 'prompt' (ask on unmatched calls) or 'deny' (refuse them outright). Sandbox: 'none' (default), 'bwrap' (run bash under bubblewrap — fs read-only, cwd+/tmp writable, secret dirs masked, no network), or 'bwrap-net' (bwrap with network). Requesting bwrap on a host without it hard-fails.
